meaning: Observe actual generated Rule guards consumed by State Machine reducers, preserving ordered nested Rule calls, exact normalized arguments, Boolean results, declared state/trigger pairs and ordered unexecuted output intents.
inputs: Exact definition and registered graph, reconciled plan and complete cross-generator boundary with matching source/plan identity. Derive reducer wrapper/provider and transitive Rule module paths, imports, value/type exports and ownership from source identity and checked contracts. Guardless nodes have no Rule-guard protocol; retain them explicitly without manufacturing guard coverage.
source_custody: Use captured immutable plan artifacts, not later authoring-directory reads. Verify their bytes against the independently source-derived controls. Copy only the selected State Machine and Rule closure into a fresh owned workspace; Event references remain identifiers and Event modules are neither copied nor loaded.
native_surface: Reuse private execution custody with a separately pinned audit profile. Source audit accounts for typed reexports, runtime imports, initial-state export and callable wrapper/provider exports. CommonJS audit accounts for erased type exports, export initialization chains, static initial-state getter forwarding and original reducer/provider bindings. Expected exports/imports come from source-derived controls. Reject unsupported imports, dynamic/nested/aliased requires, unexpected exports and listed ambient syntax. Bounded syntax checks are not universal purity.
tools: Require Node 26.8.1 and installed TypeScript 7.0.2. Bind the Node executable, complete TypeScript package tree and complete selected platform compiler package tree including native executable. Generated closure uses no ambient type packages. Reinventory tools and owned source/native/config/script/input/output bytes before and after children and at final receipt assertion. Symlinks, extras, omissions, nonregular files and changed bytes reject. This is before/after custody, not atomic filesystem isolation against concurrent privileged writers.
execution: Strict native CommonJS compilation, source/native audits, restricted instrumented execution and final/retained custody. Reuse existing structural reducer observer for inert frozen outcomes and input mutation/getter checks. Rule export wrappers call original generated functions; no expected outcomes/traces enter the child. Event modules and production providers are neither copied nor loaded. Initial-state observation is paired with an explicit empty call trace.
receipt: Deeply frozen process-registered result binds controls, plan, definition, all artifact and tool hashes and exact audit/behavior observations. Assertion rechecks retained custody. Clones cannot revive receipts. Workspace remains owned by this run and retained for its caller to inspect and clean up; failed runs expose their exact workspace path without deleting caller files.
claim_ceiling: Finite private instrumented Rule-to-State-Machine guard evidence, independent bounded module audit and before/after custody only. No universal purity, atomic filesystem isolation, uninstrumented equivalence, public whole-project pass, source capsule integration, admission, default cutover, installation or release.
oracle: Use independent checked-source structural facts and a trace-only guard API. Check all declared state by trigger pairs, valid and malformed structural inputs, invalid state/trigger symbols and initial state. No-transition, initial-state and invalid-input observations must contain no Rule calls. Match parent call index, ordered normalized named arguments and Boolean result on every actual Rule invocation. Do not derive expected outcomes or calls from generated/native source or descriptors.
cases: Bound each whole family at 4096 cases, 65536 aggregate traced calls and 8 MiB serialized controls. Require every selected transitive Rule visited and both true and false observations for each guarded transition; otherwise retain the whole family as not_evaluable, not a passing prefix or unreachable-branch proof. Repeated nested calls, source/trigger distinctions and ordered repeated output intents cannot collapse.
caller_edge_coverage: Every provider-to-Rule and Rule-to-Rule edge in the source-derived protocol must have a finite call witness identified by its exact importer and callee. Derive parent-specific edge visit counts from the independent source trace and match the original native call trace in full. A callee reached through another parent never covers an unvisited edge; retain the entire family as not_evaluable. Keep wrapper/provider forwarding distinct from Rule-call edges: forwarding is bound by source/native surface and root behavior checks, not fabricated Rule invocations.
